title: chore(names): strip whitespace in clean
body:
## Summary
Return name.strip() from clean() in src/names.py and add tests/test_names.py asserting that '  Ada ' becomes 'Ada'.

## Rationale
Names copied from forms often carry stray surrounding whitespace that prevents exact matches.

## Testing
Validation plan: run tests/test_names.py for the padded-name case.

## Limitations
Only leading and trailing whitespace is handled; internal whitespace and non-string input are not addressed.

files.patch:
diff --git a/src/names.py b/src/names.py
--- a/src/names.py
+++ b/src/names.py
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 def clean(name):
-    return name
+    return name.strip()

diff --git a/tests/test_names.py b/tests/test_names.py
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_names.py
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+from src.names import clean
+
+
+def test_clean():
+    assert clean('  Ada ') == 'Ada'
